label: Pompeo Leoni
summary: Milanese sculptor at the Spanish court who acquired most of Leonardo's papers from the Melzi heirs and bound them into large volumes, including the Codex Atlanticus and the volume now at Windsor.

claims.statement: Born about 1531 to 1533, son of the sculptor Leone Leoni.
